verdict.rationale: Runtime probe confirms the Orama JS API can create a database/index, insert documents, and run a search fully in-process with no dashboard involved, and docs describe the same create→insert→search workflow plus an official MCP server that lets AI agents (Cursor, ChatGPT) interact with project data without a UI. This satisfies the 'API or MCP' path of the story end-to-end. Missing for 10: no evidence of a dedicated CLI tool, and no confirmation that the MCP server itself supports index creation/document insertion (docs only show it 'interact[ing] with data', likely query-focused) rather than just the JS/API layer.
